description.value: The study investigated effects of rs1789891 on clinical parameters, relapse risk and brain gray matter volume in alcohol-dependent patients and healthy controls.

spans.text: Using a reverse genetic approach, the current study investigated effects of rs1789891 on clinical parameters (e.g. craving), on relapse risk and brain volume in a sample of alcohol-dependent patients and controls.

value: We hypothesized that alcohol-dependent A allele carriers consume more alcohol and have a higher relapse risk, probably because of less pronounced adverse effects after alcohol consumption.
We further hypothesized that alcohol-dependent patients have reduced brain gray matter (GM) volume compared with controls.
